title: Explain recursive invoice comparisons with exact tariff witnesses
body:
An inconclusive signed-invoice comparison currently gives hinge values but no worked cost comparison. Add `explain_recursive_invoices.py`: it emits explicit capped-linear tariffs with exact old/new paid-minus-target costs for each available sign. The existing comparator is unchanged.

Use `python3 -B scripts/explain_recursive_invoices.py OLD.json NEW.json`. The guide includes a mixed-hinge example whose power difference is `(2^t-1)^2`; this shows why opposite concave witnesses do not prove a power crossing.

Validation: all 15 invoice/comparator tests pass on Python 3.12; the 5 new tests pass under `-O`. The new suite independently replays every witness for 625 signed profiles, checks target debits and tests the real CLI under `-I -O` with SHA256 input binding. `git diff --check` passes.

The method is classical concave order, credited to the existing comparator, mightyOil’s T16 audit and retained predecessors. This is arithmetic on declared invoices, not circuit validation or a new κ. Fresh main/priorities and live overlap checks found no matching scope. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `6e1640f84f83dfa68fbd1d8db6b10630708732fd`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
